speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The panel is supported by the Expert Advisory Panel and Community Advisory Panel, comprising professionals and leaders from the investment, legal, property and religious sectors.

speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The advisory panel has conducted a series of targeted engagements with key stakeholders to better understand the community’s sentiments and identify the critical factors for WMS to succeed.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: We look forward to the recommendations and report from the council on that.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: On this front, because it is a community wakaf, and we need to make sure the barriers to entry will be as low as possible to get big, massive support and to encourage this legacy of altruism amongst our community, I hope that the council will also review and consider a more comprehensive dispute resolution framework for which any dispute arising out of a community wakaf can be dealt with either via mediation or arbitration within the framework of AMLA and under the purview of the Syariah Court, if possible.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Indeed, when the legal experts and the experts on estates met, there were many issues that needed to be studied and resolved.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: And also, for existing wakafs, what can we do with them?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: This culture of endowing properties that are given to the community by those who have passed away, is a very good culture that our forefathers started and have benefited the community today.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We would like our community today who has now gained more wealth and prospered, to do the same and benefit our community and then, hopefully, the community at large.
